description: The plot illustrates the relationship between the number of child nodes, representing tree width, and Accuracy@1 percentage for two models, GPT-4o and Claude-3. The x-axis is labeled "Number of Child Nodes (Tree Width)" with a linear scale, ranging from approximately 1 to 7, with tick labels at integer values. The y-axis is labeled "Accuracy@1 (%)" with a linear scale, ranging from 20 to 35, with tick labels at intervals of 5. The GPT-4o line is dark blue with circle markers and a solid line style, starting at 24.4% accuracy at the lowest x-value, increasing to 34.4% at an x-value of 4, and then decreasing to 31.1% at the highest x-value. The Claude-3 line is light blue with cross markers and a solid line style, beginning at 26.7% accuracy at the lowest x-value, peaking at 27.8% at an x-value of 3, and then decreasing to 20.0% at the highest x-value.
